Speak to [[Headmaster Vhang]] to begin your [[Elementalist]] training.

==Quest information==
===Requirements===
{{ Standard prerequisites
| campaign = factions
| profession = Elementalist
| primary = y
}}

===Objectives===
* Talk to [[Ludo]] to gain entrance to the [[Shing Jea Monastery|monastery]]. 
* Seek out Headmaster Vhang in the monastery. 

===Reward===
* 250 [[Experience]]
* 20 [[Gold]]

==Walkthrough==
Speak to Ludo at the entrance to Shing Jea Monastery to enter. If you skipped the tutorial [[Mantid Hatchlings]], you will learn the [[skill]]s
* {{skill icon|Aura of Restoration}}
* {{skill icon|Flare}}
* {{skill icon|Resurrection Signet}}
gain 2,000 experience, and acquire a [[Starter Elemental Rod]] after entering the monastery. You would have already received these if you did the tutorial. Speak to Headmaster Amara, who is to the right, for your reward.

==Dialogue==
===Initial dialogue===
;Ludo
:''Hello, there!  You look to be an Elementalist, am I correct?  Good, then seek out Headmaster Vhang in the monastery.  He will oversee your training while you are here.  Good luck to you!"''
{{ Offer dialog
| accept = I'll seek out Headmaster Vhang
| decline = I'm not ready to start my training yet.
| ask = '''Headmaster Vhang''' was just looking for you. He is in the monastery. you do not want to be later on your first day!
}}

===Reward dialogue===
;Headmaster Vhang
:''"So you have met Ludo, eh?  That one has the brains of an aloe seed.  I suppose he has his uses, though."''

==Notes==
*If you abandon this quest, it cannot be retaken, but you can take the following quest immediately.
